title: Ashbury Rewards Tenure and the Cancellation Scale Step — Group Room Blocks
content:
The scale percentage of a Group Room Blocks cancellation follows the organiser's Ashbury Rewards tenure:

- when the membership is active at **Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite or Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite** and was enrolled at least **120** whole months before the notice, the percentage is that of the step one longer lead than the matching step;
- when it is active at **Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite or Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite** and was enrolled at least **60** whole months before the notice, it is the average of the matching step and the step one longer lead;
- in every other case it is the matching step.

When the matching step is the top step of the block type's cancellation scale, no step has a longer lead and the step one longer lead is the top step itself.

The matching step is the step of the block type's cancellation scale that the days from the signed notice to arrival match; the step one longer lead is the step directly above it, with the next larger days-from figure. **Records read:** the tier of the organiser's active Ashbury Rewards membership and its enrolment date, tenure being counted in whole months from the enrolment date to the notice.

### Tier and tenure combined

| Active tier | Whole months enrolled before the notice | Scale percentage taken |
|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 120 or more | the step one longer lead |
| Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | fewer than 120 | the matching step |
| Gold Elite or Platinum Elite | 60 or more | the average of the matching step and the step one longer lead |
| Gold Elite or Platinum Elite | fewer than 60 | the matching step |
| Member or Silver Elite, or no active membership | any | the matching step |

### Worked on the Corporate Meeting Room Block scale (181 days 25 percent; 91 days 50 percent; 31 days 75 percent; 0 days 90 percent)

| Notice before arrival | Matching step | Titanium Elite, 130 months | Gold Elite, 70 months | Silver Elite |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 days | 50 percent | 25 percent | 37.5 percent | 50 percent |
| 20 days | 90 percent | 75 percent | 82.5 percent | 90 percent |
| 200 days (top step) | 25 percent | 25 percent | 25 percent | 25 percent |
